newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fortis up 2 pct on expected 1996 pft rise.
newsitem.headline: Fortis up 2 pct on expected 1996 pft rise.

text.p: Shares in Fortis AG, the Belgian arm of Belgo-Dutch financial group Fortis, jumped two percent on the Brussels bourse on Tuesday as investors expected Fortis to post strong 1996 results.
"Fortis is supported by a rebound from last week's profit-taking and strong 1996 results," said one trader.
Fortis AG is expected to show an increase in 1996 net profit to 13.0 billion Belgian francs from 11.2 billion in 1995. This represents an increase of just over 16 percent.
